name: LigoWave Access_point (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 7 MIB module(s). 375 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.32750.

oids.name: ligoPingTime
oids.description: The latest moving average value of ping time in milliseconds. Value -1 indicates unknown or unreachable host.

oids.name: ligoPingHost
oids.description: The hostname/domain name of a ping target if it was specified instead of an IP address in this service's configuration.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfParentIndex
oids.description: Wireless interface's parent index, which corresponds to ifIndex in MIB-II interfaces table. This is only applicable if the interface is virtual and it is created under some other interface, like it...

oids.name: ligoDot11IfAccessPoint
oids.description: Access point's MAC address if working in managed mode and connected. Current interface's MAC address, when working in master mode.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfFrequency
oids.description: Current frequency as reported by driver.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfMaxLinkQuality
oids.description: Maximum possible link quality value for current wireless card.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfAssocNodeCount
oids.description: Number of associated nodes when working in access point mode. 1 - if associated to remote access point in client mode.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfRxInvalidNWID
oids.description: Number of received packets with invalid NWID/ESSID. Increasing value usually means that there are other stations transmitting on the same channel or adjacent channels.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfRxInvalidCrypt
oids.description: Number of received packets the hardware was unable to decrypt.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfRxInvalidFrag
oids.description: Number of received packets that were missing link layer fragments for complete re-assembly.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfTxExcessiveRetries
oids.description: Number of packets hardware failed to deliver.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfInvalidMisc
oids.description: Other packets lost in relation with specific wireless operations.

oids.name: ligoDot11IfMissedBeacons
oids.description: Number of beacons that should have been sent by remote access point but were not received. Increasing number usually means that communicating peers moved out of range.

oids.name: ligoDot11RmtNodeTxBytes
oids.description: Bytes transmitted to remote node. This object is optional.

oids.name: ligoDot11RmtNodeRxBytes
oids.description: Bytes received from remote node. This object is optional.

oids.name: ligoDot11RmtNodeAssocTime
oids.description: UNIX timestamp of the association. This object is optional.

oids.name: ligoDot11RmtNodeDisassocTime
oids.description: UNIX timestamp of the disassociation (if remote node recently dissasociated). This object is optional.

oids.name: wJetIfProtoEnabled
oids.description: W-Jet protocol enabled on this interface.

oids.name: wJetIfAckRate
oids.description: Data transmission rate for management packets.

oids.name: wJetIfTxQueueMaxLength
oids.description: Maximum number of frames in transmission queue.

oids.name: wJetIfMaxAggregPackets
oids.description: Maximum packet count to be aggregated in one radio frame.

oids.name: wJetP2pRssi
oids.description: Received signal strength for this endpoint.

oids.name: wJetP2pMaxRssi
oids.description: Maximum possible signal strength value for this endpoint.

oids.name: wJetP2pRxStart
oids.description: Number of RX window Start packets received.

oids.name: wJetP2pTxStart
oids.description: Number of TX window Start packets transmitted.

oids.name: wJetP2pRxStop
oids.description: Number of RX window Stop packets received. There is no TX stops counter as it will always be equal to number of the TX start packets.

oids.name: wJetP2pTxAcked
oids.description: Number of packets acknowledged by the receiver.

oids.name: wJetP2pRxNoRetries
oids.description: Number of packets that were received without retries.

oids.name: wJetP2pTxNoRetries
oids.description: Number of packets that were transmitted without retries.

oids.name: wJetP2pRx1Retry
oids.description: Number of packets received with 1 retry.

oids.name: wJetP2pTx1Retry
oids.description: Number of packets transmitted with 1 retry.

oids.name: wJetP2pRx2Retries
oids.description: Number of packets received with 2 retries.

oids.name: wJetP2pTx2Retries
oids.description: Number of packets transmitted with 2 retries.

oids.name: wJetP2pRx3Retries
oids.description: Number of packets received with 3 retries.

oids.name: wJetP2pTx3Retries
oids.description: Number of packets transmitted with 3 retries.

oids.name: wJetP2pTxTotalRetries
oids.description: Total number of attempts to retransmit data packets.

oids.name: wJetP2pTxMaxRetries
oids.description: The maximum number of attempts to retransmit data packets. For example if data packet was retransmitted in 9th attempt, the value of this field will be 9.
